summary: Frontend-only regression of Testimonials card stack. All swipeable deck behaviors work: Next changes quote, Prev restores previous, Dot-3 jumps and marks active (w-7 wider), 5 dots present, Google rating badge visible, hero/services/contact still present. Card content readable, no clip.
critical_code_review_comments: Testimonials.jsx line 17-20: useRef(...).current pattern — the initializer runs once but useRef with an initial value returns the ref object; using .current on the created ref reads the passed value. Works, but the pattern is confusing. Consider `const reduce = useMemo(() => window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches, [])` or a simple const, and guard for SSR.
Dot onClick uses direction (i > index ? 1 : -1) but does not handle i === index (dir stays 0 which is fine); minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonials card stack (data-testid testimonial-stack/card/next/prev/dots/dot-0..4) verified working end-to-end. Auto-advance pauses on hover as expected. No issues.
